discussion_comments.comment_body: Valid — fixed in ce314ba600c58f50e19ecc2d5f9aaa2e3afaaf30. The outer `catch` no longer deletes `backup`; on a failed swap+rollback it's preserved (the only surviving copy of the previous install) and its path is written to stderr for manual recovery. Trade-off: a benign-failure path may orphan a hidden `.<name>.bmad-old-<hex>` dir, which is strictly safer than the prior data loss.
Valid — fixed in ce314ba600c58f50e19ecc2d5f9aaa2e3afaaf30. Explicit `--help`/`-h` now exits 0; a bare no-args invocation keeps `EXIT.USAGE` (2), since an incomplete call is still a usage error.
